summary: Join our Introduction to Contract Management Training Course to master key concepts and techniques for successful contract oversight and administration.
lede: Contract management training helps non-lawyers use agreements to manage obligations, suppliers and performance. For procurement, project, finance and administration professionals who handle contracts, it develops skills in interpreting key clauses, defining scope and deliverables, tracking obligations, monitoring performance, and managing changes or issues before they escalate.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly work with contracts and vendor relationships, regardless of their legal expertise. If you handle contracts as part of your role, this course is for you.
audience: Vendor and relationship managers in private
modules: Key Elements and Clauses in Contracts
Working with Suppliers, Partners, and Donors
Practical Tools and Best Practices in Contract Management
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of contract principles and some experience in roles involving contract management.
